code.description: A stable error code the app can act on.

x-known-codes.invalid_input: Something in the request needs another look (400).
x-known-codes.not_entitled: The feature is part of a paid plan (402).
x-known-codes.forbidden: The account may not do this (403).
x-known-codes.account_required: A guest space cannot do this: create an account first (403).
x-known-codes.guest_limit: The guest space is full: what a guest may keep is limited (403).
x-known-codes.not_found: There is nothing with that id (404).
x-known-codes.conflict: That clashes with something already saved (409).
x-known-codes.account_exists: There is already an account for that email (409).
x-known-codes.email_has_account: The email already belongs to an account: sign in instead (409).
